value.title: Deadlift
value.description: Full body compound movement. Engages back, glutes, hamstrings, and core. Maintain neutral spine throughout the lift.

value.title: Pull Up
value.description: Upper body pulling exercise targeting the lats and biceps. Dead hang at the bottom, chin over the bar at top.

value.title: Burpee
value.description: Full body cardio exercise combining a squat, push-up, and jump. Great for conditioning and burning calories.

value.title: Push Up
value.description: Classic upper body exercise targeting chest, shoulders, and triceps. Keep your body straight and lower until chest nearly touches the floor.

value.title: Plank
value.description: Isometric core exercise. Hold a push-up position with body in a straight line. Breathe steadily and engage your core.

value.title: Barbell Squat
value.description: King of all exercises. Targets quads, hamstrings, glutes, and core. Keep chest up and knees tracking over toes.
